title: Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL
title_zh: 政策法规调整以适应性能差距的教师调度

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning for long-horizon agents typically relies on sparse outcome-based rewards. This leads to a severe cold-start problem, as early-stage policies often fail to solve sampled tasks, leaving little useful reward signal for learning. To mitigate this problem, we use on-policy distillation (OPD) to provide token-level guidance on the student’s own rollouts. We find that the benefit of this guidance depends on the performance gap between the teacher and the student. When the teacher substantially outperforms the student, distillation helps guide the student through the early training stage where outcome rewards provide little learning signal. As the gap narrows and eventually reverses, however, continued distillation becomes less beneficial and may hinder further improvement. Motivated by this observation, we propose Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling (GATS) , which augments the student’s RL objective with an OPD term whose weight adapts to the teacher–student performance gap. Specifically, GATS gradually reduces teacher guidance as the student approaches the teacher’s reference performance and withdraws it once that reference is reached. This enables GATS to leverage task-trained teachers smaller than the student, since teacher guidance is primarily needed during early training. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher–student configurations, GATS achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods in all three configurations, improving over reward-only GRPO by 4.37%–11.87% under matched student rollout budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go .
paragraphs.zh: 长期规划智能体的强化学习通常依赖于稀疏的结果导向奖励。 这会导致严重的冷启动问题，因为早期阶段的策略往往无法解决采样任务，从而几乎没有可用的奖励信号可供学习。 为缓解这一问题，我们采用策略内蒸馏（OPD），对学生自身的执行过程提供词元级别的指导。 我们发现这种指导的效益取决于教师与学生之间的性能差距。 当教师的性能显著优于学生时，蒸馏有助于在早期训练阶段引导学生，此时结果奖励提供的学习信号微乎其微。 然而，随着差距缩小并最终逆转，持续进行蒸馏的益处会减少，甚至可能阻碍进一步的提升。 基于这一观察，我们提出了“差距自适应教师调度”（GATS），它通过增加一个与教师-学生性能差距相关的权重项来增强学生的强化学习目标。 具体而言，随着学生逐渐接近教师的参考性能水平，GATS会逐步减少教师的指导；一旦达到该参考水平，则会完全停止指导。 这使得GATS能够利用性能低于学生的任务训练教师，因为教师指导主要在早期训练阶段需要。 在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld三个环境中，结合三种Qwen2.5教师-学生配置，GATS在所有配置中均实现了所比较方法中的最高平均成功率，与仅使用奖励的GRPO相比，在匹配的学生执行预算下提升了4.37%至11.87%。 代码可在 https://github.com/Ricardo-H/guide-then-let-go 获取。

paragraphs.en: As model capabilities continue to grow, building agents that can autonomously solve complex long-horizon tasks has become a central question ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Outcome-based reinforcement learning (RL) has become a widely adopted paradigm for training such agents, as it removes the need for a critic network and thereby reduces training complexity ( Ji et al., 2026 ) . A representative approach is group relative policy optimization (GRPO), which samples a group of trajectories from the current policy and estimates the policy gradient from the relative advantages within the group to maximize the expected return ( Shao et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 随着模型能力的持续提升，构建能够自主解决复杂长期任务的智能体已成为一个核心问题（Zhou 等，2024）。 以结果为导向的强化学习（RL）已成为训练此类智能体的广泛采用的范式，因为它无需评论家网络，从而降低了训练复杂度（Ji 等，2026）。 一种代表性方法是群体相对策略优化（GRPO），它从当前策略中采样一组轨迹，并通过群体内的相对优势来估计策略梯度，以最大化期望回报（Shao 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: However, in complex long-horizon tasks, GRPO can be limited by the initial policy’s inability to discover successful trajectories within a limited rollout budget ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . When all trajectories in a sampled group fail and receive the same reward, their group-relative advantages are zero, leaving the group with no reward-driven policy-gradient signal and reducing training efficiency ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . This creates a cold-start bottleneck for outcome-based RL, raising the question of how to provide effective guidance when the initial policy cannot discover successful trajectories through exploration alone.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在复杂的长期任务中，GRPO 可能会受到初始策略的局限，因为它无法在有限的展开预算内发现成功的路径（Jiang 等人，2026；Zhang 等人，2026b）。 当采样组中的所有路径都失败并获得相同的奖励时，它们的组内相对优势为零，导致该组没有由奖励驱动的策略梯度信号，从而降低训练效率（Zheng 等人，2026）。 这为结果导向的强化学习造成了冷启动瓶颈，引发了一个问题：当初始策略仅通过探索无法发现成功路径时，如何提供有效的指导。

paragraphs.en: A straightforward way to alleviate this bottleneck is to leverage expert trajectories through supervised fine-tuning before RL ( Guo et al., 2025 ) or imitation learning during RL ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . In both cases, the expert supervision is off-policy, as the student is trained to increase the token-level likelihood of expert trajectories rather than its own rollouts. The next-token prediction objective enforces rigid, token-level imitation of the expert’s trajectory; consequently, the student tends to memorize expert-specific patterns, and the resulting gains transfer poorly beyond the training distribution ( Chu et al., 2025 ) . The problem is further aggravated by the off-policy nature of expert trajectories, as directly fitting them may disrupt the student’s established response patterns and induce overfitting to expert data ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 缓解这一瓶颈的一个直接方法是在强化学习（RL）之前通过监督微调利用专家轨迹（Guo 等人，2025），或在强化学习过程中采用模仿学习（Zhang 等人，2026a）。 在这两种情况下，专家监督都是离策略的，因为学生模型的训练目标是提高专家轨迹在词元层面的似然度，而非其自身生成的轨迹。 下一个词元的预测目标强制要求对专家的轨迹进行僵化的词元级模仿；因此，学生模型倾向于记忆专家特有的模式，而由此获得的增益在超出训练分布时难以有效迁移（Chu 等人，2025）。 专家轨迹的离策略特性进一步加剧了这一问题，因为直接拟合这些轨迹可能会破坏学生模型已形成的响应模式，并导致对专家数据的过拟合（Zhang 等人，2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Another line of work uses expert guidance to steer exploration during RL. The expert may provide a partial prefix for the model to complete ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , take over generation at designated positions ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , or contribute trajectories to the model’s rollout group ( Yan et al., 2026 ) . Despite different intervention mechanisms, these approaches inject expert information into the student’s exploration process. On-policy distillation (OPD) ( Lu and Lab, 2025 ) follows this principle by providing token-level teacher supervision on the student’s own rollouts. As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), OPD can substantially reduce the fraction of all-failure groups during early training.
paragraphs.zh: 另一类方法则利用专家指导来引导强化学习过程中的探索。 专家可以提供模型需要补全的部分前缀（Huang et al., 2025），在指定位置接管生成过程（Jiang et al., 2026），或者为模型的 rollout 组贡献轨迹（Yan et al., 2026）。 尽管干预机制不同，但这些方法都将专家信息注入到学生的探索过程中。 On-policy distillation（OPD）（Lu and Lab, 2025）遵循这一原则，通过对学生自身的 rollout 提供词元级别的教师监督。 如图 1 (a) 所示，OPD 可以在早期训练阶段显著降低全失败组的比例。

paragraphs.en: The remaining question is how long such guidance should be maintained. Existing approaches either retain the expert in the training loop or withdraw it according to a manually specified annealing curriculum ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Such schedules face a trade-off: guidance that is withdrawn too early can leave the model in the sparse-reward regime ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , whereas guidance that persists too long, or never fades at all, may restrict the student’s later improvement ( Li et al., 2026a ) . This issue is also observed for RL with fixed-weight OPD, which improves rapidly early in training but subsequently plateaus near the teacher reference, as shown in Figure 1 (b). Thus, expert guidance should adapt to the student’s training progress and be withdrawn when it is no longer beneficial.
paragraphs.zh: 剩下的问题是，这种引导应该维持多久。 现有方法要么在训练循环中保留专家，要么根据手动指定的退火课程将其撤出（Huang 等，2025；Jiang 等，2026；Liu 等，2026）。 这类计划面临一种权衡：过早撤回引导可能导致模型陷入稀疏奖励状态（Zhang 等，2026b）；而引导持续过久或完全不减弱，则可能限制学生模型后期的进步（Li 等，2026a）。 在采用固定权重 OPD 的强化学习中也观察到了这个问题：模型在训练初期迅速提升，但随后会接近教师参考水平并趋于平缓，如图 1(b) 所示。 因此，专家引导应能根据学生的训练进展进行调整，并在其不再有益时予以撤回。

paragraphs.en: To address this challenge, we first investigate when OPD is most beneficial and find that its downstream gain correlates strongly and positively with the performance gap between the expert and the student. Motivated by this, we propose GATS, which augments reinforcement learning with an OPD signal whose weight adapts to this gap. The weight is large early in training, providing stronger guidance when the student struggles to obtain reward-driven learning signals, and decreases as the gap closes. Once the student reaches the teacher reference, the teacher is withdrawn and training continues with GRPO alone. Because the expert is needed only for this early directional guidance, a small expert model suffices, which substantially reduces distillation cost. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher–student configurations show that, at the same training budget, GATS improves over GRPO by 4.37%–11.87%. Gap-adaptive on-policy distillation guides the student through the cold-start stage, where outcome rewards provide little gradient, and its automatic withdrawal leaves room for free exploration, so the student can surpass its teacher instead of merely converging to it. Ablations attribute these gains to the adaptive schedule itself rather than to distillation alone.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们首先研究了在何种情况下 OPD 最有益，并发现其下游增益与专家和学生之间的性能差距存在强正相关。 基于此，我们提出了 GATS，该方法通过引入一个权重会根据性能差距自适应调整的 OPD 信号来增强强化学习。 在训练初期，该权重较大，从而在学生难以获得奖励驱动的学习信号时提供更强的指导；随着性能差距缩小，权重也会随之降低。 一旦学生达到教师的参考水平，教师模型将被移除，训练将仅使用 GRPO 继续执行。 由于专家模型仅在早期方向引导阶段需要，因此一个小型的专家模型就足以满足需求，这显著降低了蒸馏成本。 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上，使用三种 Qwen2.5 教师-学生配置进行的实验表明，在相同的训练预算下，GATS 相比 GRPO 的性能提升了 4.37%–11.87%。 差距自适应的在线策略蒸馏方法能够引导学生在冷启动阶段（此时结果奖励提供的梯度极小）顺利推进，而该方法的自动移除机制也为自由探索留出了空间，从而使学生能够超越其教师模型，而非仅仅向其收敛。 消融实验表明，这些性能提升主要归功于自适应调度机制本身，而不仅仅是蒸馏过程。

sents.zh: 基于此，我们提出了 GATS，该方法通过引入一个权重会根据性能差距自适应调整的 OPD 信号来增强强化学习。

sents.en: The weight is large early in training, providing stronger guidance when the student struggles to obtain reward-driven learning signals, and decreases as the gap closes.
sents.zh: 在训练初期，该权重较大，从而在学生难以获得奖励驱动的学习信号时提供更强的指导；随着性能差距缩小，权重也会随之降低。

sents.en: Once the student reaches the teacher reference, the teacher is withdrawn and training continues with GRPO alone.
sents.zh: 一旦学生达到教师的参考水平，教师模型将被移除，训练将仅使用 GRPO 继续执行。

sents.en: Because the expert is needed only for this early directional guidance, a small expert model suffices, which substantially reduces distillation cost.
sents.zh: 由于专家模型仅在早期方向引导阶段需要，因此一个小型的专家模型就足以满足需求，这显著降低了蒸馏成本。

sents.en: Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three Qwen2.5 teacher–student configurations show that, at the same training budget, GATS improves over GRPO by 4.37%–11.87%.
sents.zh: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ScienceWorld 上，使用三种 Qwen2.5 教师-学生配置进行的实验表明，在相同的训练预算下，GATS 相比 GRPO 的性能提升了 4.37%–11.87%。

sents.en: Gap-adaptive on-policy distillation guides the student through the cold-start stage, where outcome rewards provide little gradient, and its automatic withdrawal leaves room for free exploration, so the student can surpass its teacher instead of merely converging to it.
sents.zh: 差距自适应的在线策略蒸馏方法能够引导学生在冷启动阶段（此时结果奖励提供的梯度极小）顺利推进，而该方法的自动移除机制也为自由探索留出了空间，从而使学生能够超越其教师模型，而非仅仅向其收敛。

sents.en: Ablations attribute these gains to the adaptive schedule itself rather than to distillation alone.
sents.zh: 消融实验表明，这些性能提升主要归功于自适应调度机制本身，而不仅仅是蒸馏过程。

paragraphs.zh: 我们的贡献可概括如下：

paragraphs.en: Through experiments, we identify a strong monotone relationship between the gain from on-policy distillation and the teacher–student performance gap, including a sign reversal at capability crossover: token-level guidance accelerates learning while the teacher is ahead, but actively suppresses the student once the gap closes.
paragraphs.zh: 通过实验，我们发现在线策略蒸馏的收益与师生性能差距之间存在强烈的单调关系，包括在能力交叉点出现符号反转：当教师模型处于领先状态时，词元级指导会加速学习；但一旦性能差距缩小，这种指导反而会主动抑制学生模型。

paragraphs.en: Building on this observation, we propose GATS, which augments the RL objective with an OPD term whose weight is an adaptive, monotone function of the measured performance gap and vanishes at crossover. GATS requires neither imitation of fixed expert trajectories nor a hand-designed annealing schedule. Moreover, since the teacher is only needed for early directional guidance, it can be smaller than the student, which substantially reduces the cost of distillation.

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement learning has been increasingly adopted to enhance the agentic capabilities of LLMs, encompassing hierarchical planning ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , tool invocation ( Feng et al., 2026 ) , and multi-turn interaction with external environments ( Jin et al., 2025 ) . Many of these methods rely on automatically verifiable feedback from the environment, such as signals of task completion ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . However, agentic RL is highly sensitive to the initial competence of the policy: stronger pretrained priors yield higher initial rewards and thereby enable more effective policy improvement, whereas weaker agents often struggle to obtain successful trajectories in long-horizon environments ( Bai et al., 2024 ) . In this cold-start regime, sparse outcome rewards cause most sampled trajectories to fail; consequently, the within-group reward variance, and hence the group-relative advantage, can collapse to zero, leaving many costly interactive rollouts without an effective learning signal ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习正被越来越多地用于提升大语言模型（LLM）的智能体能力，涵盖分层规划（Zhou 等人，2024）、工具调用（Feng 等人，2026）以及与外部环境的多轮交互（Jin 等人，2025）。 这些方法中的许多都依赖来自环境的可自动验证的反馈，例如任务完成的信号（Wang 等人，2025）。 然而，智能体强化学习对策略的初始能力高度敏感：更强的预训练先验能带来更高的初始奖励，从而更有效地改进策略；而较弱的智能体则常常难以在长时域环境中获得成功的路径（Bai 等人，2024）。 在这种冷启动状态下，稀疏的结果奖励会导致大多数采样路径失败；因此，组内奖励方差以及由此产生的组相对优势可能降至零，使得许多代价高昂的交互式展开无法获得有效的学习信号（Xi 等人，2025；Yu 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has begun to use teacher signals from on-policy distillation ( Agarwal et al., 2024 ) to compensate for the sparse outcome rewards in RLVR ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . One line of research decides which samples should receive OPD supervision based on external information, for example applying it to incorrect groups ( Li et al., 2026b ) , to groups where all rollouts fail ( Ding, 2026 ) , or to groups with large teacher–student disagreement ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Another line studies how teacher supervision should evolve over the course of training, for example linearly annealing the teacher signal to gradually reduce its influence ( Tan et al., 2026 ) . However, these methods either retain the expert in the training loop throughout the entire training process ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , which prevents the student from surpassing the teacher ceiling ( Li et al., 2026a ) , or rely on manually predefined annealing schedules ( Tan et al., 2026 ) . How to anneal the teacher signal adaptively according to the actual training dynamics, and to eventually withdraw it so that the student can surpass the teacher, remains an open problem.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究开始利用在线策略蒸馏（on-policy distillation）中的教师信号（Agarwal et al., 2024），以补偿强化学习视觉推理（RLVR）中稀疏的结果奖励（Shao et al., 2024; Yu et al., 2026）。 一类研究基于外部信息决定哪些样本应接受在线策略蒸馏的监督，例如将其应用于错误样本组（Li et al., 2026b）、所有 rollout 均失败的样本组（Ding, 2026），或教师与学生模型存在较大差异的样本组（Zhong et al., 2026）。 另一类研究探讨教师监督在训练过程中应如何演变，例如通过线性退火教师信号，逐步降低其影响（Tan et al., 2026）。 然而，这些方法要么在整个训练过程中持续保留专家模型在训练循环中（Zhang et al., 2026a），这导致学生模型无法超越教师的性能上限（Li et al., 2026a）；要么依赖手动预定义的退火计划（Tan et al., 2026）。 如何根据实际训练动态自适应地退火教师信号，并最终将其撤除以使学生模型能够超越教师，仍然是一个开放性问题。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 1 , GATS attains the highest average success rate under all three teacher-student configurations. With a Qwen2.5-1.5B teacher and a Qwen2.5-7B student, it improves the average success rate of outcome-reward-only GRPO from 52.97% to 64.84% (+11.87 points); comparable improvements of +4.37 and +11.77 points are observed in the settings with a Qwen2.5-14B student and a Qwen2.5-3B teacher, respectively. paragraphs.en: The results in Table 1 show that teacher supervision can fail in two opposite directions. On the one hand, supervision that is never withdrawn anchors the student to the capability ceiling of the teacher: GRPO + OPD and SOD perform even worse than plain GRPO, since neither of them fully withdraws the influence of the teacher. On the other hand, the annealing process in ATOD follows a predefined schedule that is decoupled from the actual training dynamics: withdrawing supervision too early re-exposes the student to the sparse-reward dilemma, whereas withdrawing it too late pulls the student toward the suboptimal teacher policy. Consequently, the performance of ATOD fluctuates sharply across configurations, with average success rates ranging from 47.66% to 61.20%. In contrast, GATS ties the supervision strength directly to the measured performance gap and withdraws supervision entirely once the student reaches the reference performance of the teacher, thereby achieving the best results across all configurations. paragraphs.en: We introduced GATS, a teacher scheduling strategy for sparse-reward agentic RL. Its central idea is to treat teacher guidance as temporary assistance: use the measured teacher–student task-performance gap to adjust the auxiliary OPD weight, then permanently withdraw the teacher when the smoothed student success rate reaches the teacher reference. Experiments on three interactive environments show gains over GRPO and distillation baselines under matched student rollout budgets, with students exceeding their smaller, task-trained teachers. Controlled schedule comparisons support adapting guidance to task progress rather than prescribing its duration in advance. Future work could explore task-specific scheduling and teacher reactivation under changing task distributions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 GATS，一种针对稀疏奖励智能体强化学习的教师调度策略。 其核心思想是将教师指导视为临时辅助：利用测得的教学员任务表现差距来调整辅助 OPD 权重，然后在平滑后的学生成功率达到教师参考值时永久撤除教师。 在三个交互式环境中的实验表明，在匹配的学生展开预算下，GATS 相较于 GRPO 和蒸馏基线方法取得了提升，且学生的表现超过了其规模较小、仅针对任务训练的教师。 受控的调度对比支持根据任务进展动态调整指导，而非预先规定指导的持续时间。 未来工作可以探索针对特定任务的调度策略，以及在任务分布变化时重新激活教师的方法。

sents.zh: 我们提出了 GATS，一种针对稀疏奖励智能体强化学习的教师调度策略。

sents.en: Its central idea is to treat teacher guidance as temporary assistance: use the measured teacher–student task-performance gap to adjust the auxiliary OPD weight, then permanently withdraw the teacher when the smoothed student success rate reaches the teacher reference.
sents.zh: 其核心思想是将教师指导视为临时辅助：利用测得的教学员任务表现差距来调整辅助 OPD 权重，然后在平滑后的学生成功率达到教师参考值时永久撤除教师。

sents.en: Experiments on three interactive environments show gains over GRPO and distillation baselines under matched student rollout budgets, with students exceeding their smaller, task-trained teachers.
sents.zh: 在三个交互式环境中的实验表明，在匹配的学生展开预算下，GATS 相较于 GRPO 和蒸馏基线方法取得了提升，且学生的表现超过了其规模较小、仅针对任务训练的教师。

sents.en: Controlled schedule comparisons support adapting guidance to task progress rather than prescribing its duration in advance.
sents.zh: 受控的调度对比支持根据任务进展动态调整指导，而非预先规定指导的持续时间。

sents.en: Future work could explore task-specific scheduling and teacher reactivation under changing task distributions.
sents.zh: 未来工作可以探索针对特定任务的调度策略，以及在任务分布变化时重新激活教师的方法。
